import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    k = (n + 1) // 2
    smallest_k = heapq.nsmallest(k, a)
    print(smallest_k[(n - 1) // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
